title: Due Day Changes on the Installment Payment Plans
content:
**Conditions.** On the **Installment Payment Plans**, a due day change is made only on a plan whose status is current. The plan must allow due day changes, the due day changes already used in the term must be below the plan's allowance, and the new due day may move the next due date by no more than the plan's largest shift in calendar days, earlier or later. The request is made at least the plan's minimum lead in calendar days before the next installment due date. The final installment must still fall due before the term expiration date.

**Effect.** The change applies to every installment not yet invoiced; already issued invoices keep their due dates, and no fee is charged.

**Evidence.** The plan's status, its count of due day changes used and the next installment's due date, as the system records them.

**Boundary illustration (hypothetical; Cardinal Point Four-Pay Plan: allowed, shift of up to 10 days, one change per term, request at least 5 days before the next due date).** The next installment is due on the 20th.

| Request | Result |
|---|---|
| made on the 15th, moving the due day to the 28th | qualifies: 5 days before, shift of 8 |
| made on the 16th | does not qualify: only 4 days before |
| made on the 10th, moving the due day to the 31st | does not qualify: shift of 11 |
| plan is past due | does not qualify: status is not current |
| a change was already made this term | does not qualify: allowance of 1 used |

On the Cardinal Point Paid-in-Full Plan and the Cardinal Point Two-Pay Plan due day changes are not allowed.
